known_behavior_summary: Al'Akir is entry 46753 on map 754; the historical spawn is (-49.64583, 815.0816, 191.1009), with InhabitType 12 in historical SQL.
The repository requires Conclave of Wind DONE before removing Al'Akir's immune-to-player flag and summoning four slipstreams (47066).
The local ground-phase scheduler starts Wind Burst at 23s, Lightning Strike at 9s, Ice Storm at 5s, Squall Line at 10s, and Berserk at 10m; heroic Static Shock starts at 5s.
The local 80% gate starts mode-selected Acid Rain and Stormlings; the 25% gate enables flight, breaks the platform, starts Relentless Storm, and removes ground-phase hazards.
Local phase-3 selectors use 110 yards exact 2D for the Relentless Storm ride exclusion, 10 yards vertical for Lightning Clouds damage, and 5 yards vertical for Lightning Rod damage.

Current guides agree qualitatively on Electrocute, Lightning Strike, Wind Burst, Ice Storm, Squall Line, Acid Rain, Stormlings, platform break, altitude clouds, and Lightning Rod, but exact 4.4.2 quantitative behavior is not frozen.
On local death, Acid Rain is removed, Serenity is cast, chest 95386 is summoned and tracked world-trigger auras are removed; historical loot/currency rows are not current-client proof.

lifecycle.precondition: Conclave of Wind DATA_CONCLAVE_OF_WIND must be DONE; otherwise instance creation applies UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_PC to Al'Akir.
lifecycle.engage: BossAI::JustEngagedWith sets encounter frame, aggressive reaction, phase one and ground timers; slipstreams are despawned.
phase_transitions: HealthBelowPctDamaged(80, damage) while phase one starts Acid Rain, heavy rain and Stormling scheduling.
HealthBelowPctDamaged(25, damage) while phase two enables CanFly, stops ground attack, removes Acid Rain/too-close knockback, cancels Squall Line and starts phase-three actors.
lifecycle.reset: Reset invokes BossAI reset and respawns the slipstream summon group only when Conclave is DONE.
lifecycle.evade: Evade removes player Acid Rain, despawns summons, restores platform/draft, removes world-trigger auras and despawns at evade; instance FAIL restores weather/light and clears tracked phase-three vehicles.
lifecycle.death: JustDied invokes BossAI death handling, removes Acid Rain, casts Serenity 89750 to players, summons chest 95386, moves the boss with MoveFall and removes world-trigger auras.
lifecycle.credit: Historical instance encounter row is 46753 -> encounter 317 ('Al'Akir'); historical currency rows exist for 46753/50203/50217/50231 and creature lootid is 0. Current Classic credit/loot is unresolved.
lifecycle.difficulty_delta: Heroic local behavior is Static Shock scheduling and the Lightning Strike chain-caster path; mode coefficients and current difficulty entries are not frozen.
